# Job Posting: Accounts Assistant (Full-time)

Harbor Precision Ltd.

Posted: October 1, 2026

Application deadline: September 30, 2026

## 1 About the company

Harbor Precision Ltd. designs and makes precision parts. We have 120 employees, and our head office is in Portland.

## 2 What you will do

You will join the accounts team and handle the following work.

1. Enter vouchers and check the journal entries
2. Issue invoices to customers
3. Process payments and check incoming receipts
4. Prepare the monthly closing reports
6. Check expense claims

## 3 Terms

| Item | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Employment | Full-time, permanent |
| Probation | 3 months |
| Salary | $5,000–$4,500 a month |
| Bonus | Twice a year, three months' salary in total |
| Example annual pay | $75,000 (third year, with a monthly salary of $4,800) |
| Working hours | 9:00–18:00 with a 60-minute break, 7 hours a day |
| Days off | Two days off every week (Saturday and Sunday) and public holidays |
| Annual days off | 90 days |
| Location | Head office, Portland |

## 4 Requirements

- Two or more years of experience in accounting
- Able to build summary tables in a spreadsheet

## 5 Other information

The probation period is 6 months, and pay and benefits during it are the same as after it.

## 6 How to apply

Send your résumé and a summary of your work history by post to the Recruiting Team, General Affairs, Harbour Precision Ltd. We will contact you with an interview date after reviewing your documents.
